g.title: turn
g.text: How the heuristic bot plays a turn
deterministic rules; percentages are how often each branch was taken in 1000 heuristic-only games (75 turns and 2.8 main-phase decisions per turn on average)

g.title: preroll
g.text: knight in hand and the robber
next to one of its buildings?

g.title: robber
g.text: pips × Σ buildings on it: opponent's (1 or 2) × (1 + their VP),
then steal from the victim with the most VP (+ cards/10)

g.title: discard
g.text: one card at a time: the resource it holds most of

g.title: main
g.text: Main phase: the first rule that applies is played
any legal site; highest corner score
on its settlement with the highest corner score
only if the robber sits next to one of its buildings
only if it has no free settlement site
only if both cards fill a shortfall for the target
only if no free site; toward the best site two corners away
only if the target is a dev card or a road
once per turn: 1 spare card for 1 missing target card
Trade with the bank or a port
give a surplus resource for a missing one

g.title: respond
g.text: accept if the offer shrinks its own shortfall

g.title: follow
g.text: next main-phase action in the same turn

g.title: target
g.text: 1. a city, if it has a settlement to upgrade
2. a settlement, if a free site is connected
3. a road, if it has roads and settlements left
Trades, Year of Plenty and dev-card buying all

g.title: confirm
g.text: take the acceptance or counter that
shrinks its shortfall most, else cancel

g.title: never
g.text: play Monopoly · ask others for offers (invite)
offer more than 1 card for 1 · save cards on purpose
(it passes only when nothing is affordable)
